description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Home' using the Blits framework. It imports components, sets up a template with animated elements, manages component state and lifecycle hooks, and includes some methods for visual effects.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component that serves as the homepage layout, incorporating logo animations, a loader, and a button with transitioning effects.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Cycles through predefined colors to animate the loader component's color.
